### Wanted: Jesus Coaches
Author: Doug Fields
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/wanted-jesus-coaches-homeword-june-4.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:1
Points:
- Just as technical sports require coaching, following Jesus is too complex to navigate alone.
- Churches often welcome new Christians without offering the hands-on guidance they need.
- Being a mentor is about building genuine relationships and modeling faith, not running programs.
- Believers with any degree of spiritual maturity have valuable experience to share.
- Christians should intentionally step up to listen, love, and coach newer believers.

### A Role You Can Play
Author: Jill Beran
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-may-18-2016.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:1
Points:
- Believers often feel unqualified or intimidated by the prospect of becoming mentors.
- Effective mentors do not need all the answers; they simply need to be available and honest.
- Sharing past mistakes openly helps others avoid the same missteps in their walk.
- Mentoring naturally flows out of a dedicated personal choice to follow Jesus Christ.
- God calls believers to pass along the lessons they have already received.

### Parable of the Ducks
Author: Jim Burns
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-jan-24-2011-11644471.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:1
Points:
- Søren Kierkegaard's parable shows ducks agreeing they can fly yet continuing to waddle.
- Verbal instruction has limited impact if not matched by practical demonstration.
- Passing down faith effectively requires living out convictions before others.
- Spiritual influence begins with actively addressing the shortcomings in one's own life.
- A godly example has the power to shape lives for generations to come.

### Faithful Role Models
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-apr-20.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 11:1
Points:
- Early childhood faith is strongly influenced by seeing parents consistently pray and seek God.
- Children rarely forget the authentic example of faith they observe from infancy onward.
- Early spiritual memories often remain present even if children later wander away.
- Scripture charges parents with the duty and privilege of nurturing children in faith.
- Parents must seek God's grace so their daily actions reflect Christ clearly.
